author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
If you've been to a Cirque du Soleil show, you know there's a lot of swinging and spinning of performers from cables. How does a traveling, outdoor show -- which needs to minimize weight and accommodate local weather conditions -- balance cost with safety? Head of rigging Mitch Marines explains to theater nerd and former rigger Adam Savage how ECHO thrills audiences each day while keeping its performers safe.
